title: TenantPolicy
description: Tenant hierarchy and configuration inheritance for the document seam, version 0.1.0. DXP evidence: tenant comes from the signed token (never a loose header); endpoints, credentials and the seam binding live per tenant in CM Mediator (ADR-010). CONFIRMED by the product owner 2026-11-06: a 'master tenant' is a parent that owns shared configuration and child tenants inherit it; the DXP documents do not define the term, so this definition is ours. Documents themselves never cross tenants; only configuration is inherited.

parentTenantId.description: Required when role = child. A child has exactly one master; no deeper nesting in 0.1.0.

frontendStrategy.description: The DXP frontend tenancy strategies named in ADR-010.

documents.description: Document metadata, versions, extraction, audit and content are readable only inside the owning tenant.

crossTenantShare.description: explicitGrant = a named document shared to named tenant(s) by a person with the right, each grant audited and revocable.

masterSupervision.description: What the master tenant can see of a child's documents without a share. metadataOnly = counts and states, never content, names or fields. auditOnGrant = content access only through a time-boxed, audited grant.

inheritance.description: Per configuration kind, how a child relates to the master. Resolution order: tenant value if mode allows, else master value, else platform default.

hardFloors.description: Values a child may tighten but never loosen (master-set minimums). Evaluated by the seam and by OPA.

mode.description: inherit = use the master as is. extend = master items plus own items. override = own item replaces the master's of the same code. locked = master item, child cannot change or hide it.
